title: Email: Cloudflare for inbound and platform system mail (SendGrid fallback), SendGrid for agency mail
goal: Incoming mail is received by Cloudflare Email Routing; the platform's own system mail is sent through Cloudflare's Workers email sending with an automatic and manual fallback to SendGrid; all agency mail stays on SendGrid.
steps: ADR-002 section 6.1: one EmailProvider interface (send, events) with SendGrid, Cloudflare and mock implementations; first with no behaviour change (all mail on SendGrid), proven by the existing tests.

Routing rule: platform system mail (welcome, invites, reset, receipts, platform alerts) goes to Cloudflare when EMAIL_SYSTEM_PROVIDER=cloudflare and the send_email binding exists; on a Cloudflare error or quota refusal, retry once on SendGrid and record which provider sent it; agency transactional and marketing mail always go to SendGrid.

Inbound (ADR-002 6.2): an Email Worker handler (the worker's email() export) for Email Routing that files replies to agency threads in the Communication Hub inbox of the right agency (reply-to addresses carry an unguessable per-thread token, building on R128); size limits; spam and auth results recorded; unknown addresses dropped.

Config: send_email binding and EMAIL_SYSTEM_PROVIDER (sendgrid|cloudflare, default sendgrid) through gen-wrangler; local stacks use the mock provider and the outbox; nothing calls Cloudflare or SendGrid from tests or local stacks.
Docs: GO-LIVE (DNS records from ADR-002 6.4: Email Routing MX, SPF, DKIM for both providers, DMARC), KEYS-AND-ACCOUNTS (sender verification), INFRA; rollback = EMAIL_SYSTEM_PROVIDER=sendgrid.
tests: fallback to SendGrid on a Cloudflare failure
an inbound reply lands in the right agency and nowhere else
gate: e2e communication-inbox + first-login + campaigns on a local stack
goLiveVerify: Cloudflare sending onboarding for the platform domain
a real reply from an external mailbox reaches the agency inbox
notes: Cloudflare sending is in beta and transactional-only (ADR-002): agency marketing must never route to it.
